notes: In-Project Indicator: Green top bar on files in your project

pages.title: In-Project Indicator
pages.description: Files that are already in your Premiere Pro or After Effects project now show a green top bar automatically. The indicator refreshes every 5 seconds so new imports are detected right away.

pages.title: Relink All Files
pages.description: Fix offline or missing media with one click. The plugin searches by file name, previous names, size, and modification date to find and relink your files automatically.

pages.title: Smart Folder Operations
pages.description: Moving folders now relinks all files inside them. Renaming files tracks their history so they can always be found. Everything stays connected in your project.
